translations.english: The arrows released by both Rama and Ravana were without result. None failed to reach the target. None failed to complete the target. The arrows were colliding with one another and fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: किन्तु वशे जा कर, उन वूटियां को न पहचान सकने के रण वे चिन्तित हुए । तब अमितबलशालो पवननन्दन ने मन मन यह निश्चित किआ कि,
